reviews.x: I ordered this hair chalk for nieces birthday and she loves them! She loves that she can apply the colors to her hair and match what she is wearing that day. It is easy to apply and no damage done to her hair like hair dye does. The hair chalk shipped promptly and was delivered when expected. I highly recommend this product!
good results! Awesome color! My girls are addicted to these things. I bought these for my daughter's birthday. Children like them. The color is very good, beautiful and fun!
Wish i grabbed some photos before i washed this out, but I used it and rocked out in the photobooth. Was really vibrant on my blonder hair and still bright on my darker hair. No complaints
I love it This hair chalk really helps me Beautiful, colorful, healthy I can change my hair color every day Children, adults, old people Everyone can use it! Fantastic!!!!!
These are great for halloween. They work best if your hair is pretty wet when applying. The color pops out pretty good!

I really liked the colors included. Most other kits come with only 4 or 5 colors. As with all hair chalk I have used, this works better on lighter colored hair. My kids love it for crazy hair day at school. My son gets really sweaty, so it won't last the day with him. My daughter likes to color each strand of her braid separately. It will stain your hands when you apply, but washes off with soap and water. For some reason the pink didn't wash out after one wash like the rest of the colors did.

We are getting ready for Halloween. I tried this on my blonde daughter. All the colors worked great except for white. First style the hair and then apply the color. I first tried wetting the hair and rubbing the chalk on but that didn’t work so well. What worked was dipping the chalk in water and then rubbing the hair with the chalk. reviews.t: Beautiful colors and small, meant for strips of the hair.
reviews.x: I bought this as a gift for my niece (10 years old) who wanted to dye her hair but her parents would not allow it.This hair chalk can let her get a temporary color just for fun.She use it at a cosplay event party and she was complimented everywhere. Really vibrant colors and rinse out easily with just shampoo. Work perfectly especially on blonde hair.Definitely recommend but don't expect professional results as shown in the online photos .

I have now purchased this excellent product four times for myself and as gifts! Including my 70 yo aunt who was constantly dying her hair bright colors, but now doesn't have to! Goes on easy, stays on. Washes out in one good scrub. I'm pretty chemically sensitive but these don't bother me at all. Highly recommend!

Light taste, fast coloring, can be completed in more than ten minutes, mild nature, no irritation to scalp, lasting coloring, no discoloration, convenient washing, easy to pass water, no rough hair after washing

Easy to apply and can put in little streaks or apply broadly for more color. As the package says, it shows better in blonde hair, but it still shows in brown hair, too. It can wash out easily.My 6 year old daughter LOVES these hair chalks comb so much! She has medium hair and colour shows up great on her hair.Now she is looking forward to the upcoming Halloween party and Christmas party.So fun!Well worth the price.

I haven used this colored hair chalks for a couple of weeks and I like the quality of the product. It is good for who wants hair decoration for parties, clubs , perfomances, for Halloween parede and so on. Also, it’s s great idea to put in kids hair because is not temporary and doesn’t have chemicals. I put on the hair of 6yo girl I baby sit for and it looked great! She was very happy with her colorful hair.

These chalks are super easy to apply, are very bright, and don't leave as much of a residue as others. Absolutely love this product!Loved everything about this product. I love how I can use many different colors and the colors actually don't run into each other making a color of its own. Washes out with shampoo and my hair isn't dried out or damaged at all.

I was really looking forward to receiving this, and to be able to add some temporary color to my hair, but it was not effective at all. It doesn't show much on dark hair, and what little showed would just disappear if I even touched it or tried to comb or shape my hair. It comes of too easily. I really wanted to like this, but sadly was disappointed.

reviews.t: Any color of hair can be used
reviews.x: I bought it for my niece’s birthday gift, because she has been researching hair coloring. After trying it, she likes it very much. Her brown hair can also be used, maybe the color of blond hair will be more obvious. The color didn't get anything on except my hands, and it was easy to wash off. The price is very low but the effect is really good.

I love the great selection of colors of this hair chalk set! And it's also a lot less messy than the spray on hair color for sure. It's a little tricky on smooth fine hair though. Not sure why the add customer photo button has disappeared so I can't share a photo right now. Basically it's easier to stay on textured hair.

These weren’t great. I used them at a slumber party and really the colors only showed up on the blondest of hair. They were also a little messy and took a while to get color pay off and the color didn’t really last very long on most hair. The girls had fun with them but I wouldn’t repurchase.

They like to use it on my hair. Its colors are very bright, and I like that it has many different colors. They are embedded in a brush made of chalk, so all you have to do is hold the handle and brush it into your hair. Very simple, even my youngest child can do it!

We've tried several hair chalk products on my daughter's long, blonde hair and none have been even close to this one in quality. These chalks are super easy to apply, are very bright, and don't leave as much of a residue as others. Absolutely love this product!

reviews.t: Worth the money, great color and EASY to use!
reviews.x: These are GREAT!!! I tried them this morning after they came on my daughter, talk about easy and GREAT COLOR!!! I will buy these again!! I should also say, this is me pressing LIGHTLY her hair was already done.. i just wanted to play with them a little :)

We really liked this product for ease of use and the ability to wash off so easily. My daughter has very dark brown hair and it brightened up her hair! My 12 yr old and 3 yr old twins really love playing with the chalk in their hair and as face paint.

reviews.x: I bought it for my sister. She likes it very much. When used, her hair is a bit sticky and stiff. After a while, she can run her fingers through her hair. It feels as if she already has hairspray, but once it's set, it will disappear. Value for money

The colors may not be vibrant but you can see them,especially on light colored hair. I have silver hair & the colors show very well. The colors only last for about 2-3 hours & washes out very well. The mascara type application is very simple.

This works far better than I would have thought. My daughter really likes it. It is fun and subtle. She loves being able to chalk her own hair.Colors are bright.Washes out easy. Leaves no residue after or on clothing during. Great product！

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the colors as vibrant, bright, and fun, especially for kids and parties.
Many reviewers say the chalk is easy to apply and washes out easily.
Several reviewers note the color shows best on lighter or blonde hair and is less effective on dark hair.
Some reviewers mention the color can come off easily or not last the day, especially with sweat or touching.
Reviewers commonly bought it as a gift for children and say kids love it.
